name: cap_discover
description: Check whether a website has a CAP front door, and whether visitors can log in.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: The company domain, such as example.com

name: cap_ask
description: Send one question to a company's CAP front door and wait up to 60 seconds.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: The company domain, such as example.com

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: The question to send. On a follow-up, send only the new question.

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: A short brief such as sizes, dates, or style. Not a profile.

arguments.name: conversation_id
arguments.desc: The conversation_id from the previous cap_ask, when this continues that conversation.

name: cap_check
description: Read a CAP message that was still being answered.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: The company domain used in cap_ask
